name: MOLSLINJEN's ferries Aarhus–Odden, Ebeltoft–Odden, trucks
law: MOLSLINJEN's freight prices per single trip, excluding VAT, on Aarhus–Odden, Ebeltoft–Odden: Forvogn to 12 m DKK 1100; Sættevogn to 17 m DKK 1500; Vogntog to 19 m DKK 1500 (DKK up to 12 m 1100, 12-19 m 1500 by length). Its ETS fee (DKK 152, 200) isn't added: carbon-cost prices the EU ETS on the crossing from the ships' MRV data. Other vehicles to 25 m are priced only "from DKK 3,300": not used. The page gives no date: valid_from is the day it was first read. Ports at OpenStreetMap's ferry terminals, priced where the line goes out on its car ferry line.
